description: RSAS is a closed-loop agricultural system helping farms adapt to compound climate stresses — drought, heat, and frost. NASA POWER, SMAP and MODIS data plus IoT sensors predict stress events days ahead and trigger three coordinated responses: engineered rhizosphere microbes, a biodegradable polymer spray, and dynamic agrivoltaic panels that shade crops in heat and warm them on frost nights. One NASA-driven decision loop, continuously self-updating. Proof-of-concept level.
